item_short_desc: Rothco’s Tactical Cover Up Sleeves are designed to provide a clean and professional look by covering tattoos with style and comfort. Made from breathable, moisture wicking performance material, these sleeves ensure all-day comfort in any environment. Ideal for jobs that require a neat appearance, the sleeves also offer protection against the sun and can be worn under uniforms for added warmth. The upper arm interior features a rubber field for a non-slip, secure fit, ensuring the sleeves stay in place throughout the day.
